texts.facts: 2. Brief facts, as per the case of the applicant in this application are as such that the applicant is having a business of cattle firm of cow belonging to the Gir and Kankreji breed of Gujarat. Those who are interested in buying the Gir and Kankreji breed for their cattle farm, they contact the applicant as the applicant's firm - Shree Dhara Naturals. Purushothaman Veeraragvan, a farmer from Tamilnadu having his ancestral land at Village: Cheyyur, Dist.: Kanchipuram, contacted the applicant as he wanted to develop his Cattle farm. Shree Dhara Naturals agreed to supply 27 cattle for the breeding purpose only. Four persons were engaged by Shree Dhara Naturals to transport 27 cattle to Tamilnadu for Purushothaman Veeraraghavan. These four persons were arrested by the police while they were transporting 27 cattle with all care and comfort from Dhara Naturals farm of Vadodara to Tamilnadu on a suspicion that the cattle is taken to a slaughter house and FIR was registered at the instance of one private person - Dipenkumar Rameshbhai Parmar, who claims to be an activist against NEUTRAL CITATION R/CR.MA/22476/2017 JUDGMENT DATED: 08/06/2023 undefined animal cruelty. It is further the case of the applicant in this applicant that all the four persons were released on bail by the learned J.M.F.C. on 23.04.2017. The Laxmanbhai Govindbhai Vankar, who is the owner of the Dhara Naturals was also released on bail on 27.04.2017. It is further the case of the applicant in this applicant that thereafter, applicant made an application on 26.04.2017 for release of the cattle and his application came to be rejected by the learned J.M.F.C. by order dated 12.06.2017. Thereafter, the applicant preferred the Misc. Criminal Revision Application no.147/2017 and it has also been rejected by ordered dated 10.07.2017 passed by Learned Additional Sessions Judge, Vadodara. Thereafter, the present petition is preferred.
